description: This file contains unit tests for the Router class's methods related to initializing interaction endpoints. It verifies the creation and re-initialization of API endpoint methods, as well as testing the correct passing of a custom language model provider parameter in asynchronous endpoint initialization functions.

classes.name: TestInitializeInteractionsEndpoints
classes.description: Contains test cases to verify the initialization and re-initialization of interaction endpoint methods on the Router class.

classes.name: TestInitInteractionsApiEndpoints
classes.description: Contains asynchronous test cases for the _init_interactions_api_endpoints method, ensuring correct passing of the custom_llm_provider parameter.

methods.name: test_initialize_interactions_endpoints_creates_methods(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the _initialize_interactions_endpoints method creates expected interaction methods on the Router instance.

methods.name: test_initialize_interactions_endpoints_can_be_called_directly(self)
methods.description: Checks that re-initializing endpoints via _initialize_interactions_endpoints doesn't remove previously added methods.

methods.name: test_init_interactions_api_endpoints_passes_custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Ensures the _init_interactions_api_endpoints method correctly passes a custom_llm_provider parameter to the original function.

methods.name: test_init_interactions_api_endpoints_defaults_to_gemini(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the default value 'gemini' is used for the custom_llm_provider when none is provided.

methods.name: test_init_interactions_api_endpoints_does_not_override_existing_provider( self, )
methods.description: Ensures that if custom_llm_provider is provided in the call, it is used directly without override.
